corpus.text: Refund requests must be submitted within 14 calendar days of purchase. The purchase date is day zero for this policy.
Once a refund is approved, funds are sent to the original payment method and usually arrive within 5 to 7 business days.
Digital purchases may be refunded within 14 days only if the product has not been downloaded. Downloaded digital products are not eligible for refunds.
Orders are dispatched within two business days. A tracking link is sent after the parcel is dispatched.
Shipping and delivery fees are non-refundable, even when an order's product price is refunded.
Customer support is available Monday through Friday. The support team is closed on Saturday and Sunday.
Support tickets usually receive an initial response within 24 business hours. Complex requests may take longer.
Customers can cancel subscriptions at any time before the next renewal date. Access remains active until the current billing period ends.
Subscriptions renew every 30 days, and the next subscription payment is charged on the renewal date.
Invoices are available in the account billing dashboard. Each invoice can be downloaded as a PDF and contains the purchase date and order reference.
Never share your account password. Enable two-factor authentication to add an extra security layer.
The document assistant accepts PDF and DOCX files. Scanned image-only PDFs may need OCR to extract searchable text.
